planning_intelligence.rule: If the planning model's usage is exhausted / rate-limited (HTTP 429), the planning lane MUST switch to the fallback GLM-5.3 on OPENCODE GO. Configured as fallback_providers[0] so the chain lands on it first.

sod_limitations: When the planning fallback is ACTIVE, PLANNING and VERIFY both run on OPENCODE GO in the GLM-5.3 family. They remain distinct roles with distinct artifacts, but they are NOT model-independent. Declared, not hidden.
The maker lane (deepseek-v4.1-flash) and the checker lane (glm-5.3-flash) are different models, which is the separation that matters for the acceptance verdict.
